title: Ex 10: What Was That?
checklist: 改几个数字/字符串再跑
body:
# Ex 10 · What Was That?

转义字符：`\n` `\t` `\\` 以及引号转义。

## 目标
- 认识常见转义
- 会在字符串里嵌套引号

## 自检
- [ ] 能指出哪一行用了 tab
- [ ] 试着打印带双引号的句子

starterFiles.ex10.py:
tabby_cat = "\tI'm tabbed in."
persian_cat = "I'm split\non a line."
backslash_cat = "I'm \\ a \\ cat."

fat_cat = """
I'll do a list:
\t* Cat food
\t* Fishies
\t* Catnip\n\t* Grass
"""

print(tabby_cat)
print(persian_cat)
print(backslash_cat)
print(fat_cat)
